visualReview.observed: The mobile menu shows later Brutalist entries, with the current Button leaf near the bottom; the Brutalist summary is not visible. This is a post-observation screenshot, not proof of the instantaneous failure state.

provenFacts: Seven measurements have every original point above the viewport and all hits null, with no active animation and no document scroll.
The same target also passes 13 of 20 diagnostic attempts; passing group bounds have y506 while failed group bounds have y-1122.
All failed native summary snapshots lack data-site-link-enhanced. Existing mobile enhanced test only waited for the contents trigger, not the group/leaf projection population.
finding.causeBoundary: No scroll writer stack or enclosing scroll-owner state beyond the recorded eight ancestors was captured; a specific writer is not proven by this artifact. The current visibility policy can legitimately continue reveal before actual user input.
finding.acceptedNextStep: Wait for actual group/leaf enhancement under the existing 20s condition, establish and observe real native wheel user control, retain all original hit/height/radius assertions, compare the same twenty attempts and rerun final clean acceptance.
